channel.title: Spreadsheets for small service businesses
channel.description: Bookkeeping and income and expense trackers for cleaners, handymen, lawn care and other small service businesses.

item.title: Profit by Service Chart for Cleaning, Lawn Care and Handyman Businesses
item.description: A bookkeeping spreadsheet for service businesses with a job profit by service chart, so you can see whether house cleaning, window cleaning, lawn care or handyman work earns the most. Also tracks unpaid invoices, expenses by category and a tax set-aside estimate. Excel and Google Sheets, no macros. $19 instant download.

item.title: Small Business Bookkeeping Spreadsheet for Service Businesses (Excel + Google Sheets)
item.description: A small business bookkeeping spreadsheet built for cleaners, handymen, lawn care, detailers and pressure washers. Log each job and expense and get a dashboard with profit by month, profit per job, unpaid invoices and a tax set-aside estimate. Works in Excel and Google Sheets. No macros. $19, instant download.

item.title: Cleaning Business Profit Tracker Spreadsheet: Profit on Every Job
item.description: A cleaning business profit tracker that shows profit and margin on every job after materials, helper pay and mileage. Also works for window cleaning, pressure washing, lawn care and handyman work. Includes a dashboard, expense log and monthly profit and loss. Excel and Google Sheets, no macros. $19 download.

item.title: Google Sheets Bookkeeping Template for Self-Employed and Service Businesses
item.description: A Google Sheets bookkeeping template (also an Excel file) for self-employed people and small service businesses. Monthly profit and loss, expenses by category, profit by service and unpaid invoices by age. Real formulas, no macros, and a step-by-step Start Here tab for opening it in Google Sheets. $19 instant download.

item.title: Unpaid Invoice Tracker Spreadsheet with 30/60/90 Day Aging
item.description: Keep track of who still owes you money. This small business spreadsheet marks every invoice Paid, Unpaid or Overdue, counts the days unpaid and groups what is owed by age: 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and over 90 days. Part of a full bookkeeping and profit dashboard for Excel and Google Sheets. $19.

item.title: Job Profit Tracker for Service Businesses: Job Costing Spreadsheet
item.description: A job profit tracker for service businesses: enter the invoice, materials, helper pay and miles driven and the sheet works out job profit and margin. See which services earn the most, then price and schedule accordingly. Dashboard, reports and expense log included. Excel and Google Sheets. $19 instant download.

item.title: Self-Employed Tax Set-Aside Tracker and Bookkeeping Spreadsheet
item.description: Know how much to set aside for taxes. This self-employed bookkeeping spreadsheet totals your net profit each quarter and applies a set-aside percentage you choose, so tax time is not a surprise. A planning estimate, not tax advice. Includes job profit, expenses and a dashboard. Excel and Google Sheets. $19.

item.title: Free Income and Expense Tracker for Small Business (Excel + Google Sheets)
item.description: A free income and expense tracker for small business owners. Log payments and expenses, then see income, expenses and profit by month, spending by category and income by type, with charts. Real formulas, no macros, works in Excel and Google Sheets. Pay what you want, including $0.

item.title: Free Google Sheets Income and Expense Tracker Template
item.description: A free Google Sheets income and expense tracker template. Upload the file to Google Drive and open it with Google Sheets, or use it in Excel. Dropdown categories you can rename, a monthly summary and charts. Made for freelancers and small service businesses. Pay what you want, even $0.

item.title: Free Simple Bookkeeping Spreadsheet for Self-Employed and Freelancers
item.description: A simple free bookkeeping spreadsheet for the self-employed and freelancers. Record income and expenses, then check monthly profit, profit margin and spending by category on one summary page. A sample file and a blank copy are included. Works in Excel and Google Sheets. Pay what you want, even $0.

item.title: Free Expense Tracker for Cleaning, Handyman and Lawn Care Businesses
item.description: A free expense tracker for cleaning, handyman, lawn care, detailing and pressure washing businesses. Categories for fuel, supplies, tools, insurance, phone, advertising and helper pay, with a summary of spending by category. Excel and Google Sheets, no macros. Pay what you want, even $0.
